job.title: Junior Kubernetes & Cloud Platform Engineer
job.description: KubeStack Solutions (Pune) builds managed Kubernetes platforms for enterprise clients. We seek a Junior Cloud Platform Engineer proficient in Kubernetes architecture, kubectl, Helm charts, ingress controllers, and container networking.

pool.text: Kubernetes Architecture: core knowledge of Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Namespaces
Helm Package Manager: authored modular Helm charts with values.yaml parameterization and templating
Ingress Controllers & Cert-Manager: configured Nginx Ingress with automated Let's Encrypt SSL certificates
Container Security: scanned image vulnerabilities using Trivy and enforced non-root security contexts
KubeLab: multi-node lightweight K3s cluster configured on local VMs running Prometheus and ingress
B.E. Computer Science, Pune University (Cummins / MIT), 2022–2026, CGPA 8.7/10
Docker & Containerd: built efficient container images and debugged container runtime crashes
Android Java: created student GPA calculator app
Cloud Platform Intern at PuneTech (Pune, 3 months): migrated standalone Docker apps into Kubernetes pods
GitOps with ArgoCD: synchronized Kubernetes manifests automatically from Git repository branches
Graphic Design: made club banners using Canva
Linux CLI & Networking: used cURL, netstat, ip, and traceroute to debug inter-pod connectivity
